module_description: Advanced topics in robotic kinematics, control systems, locomotion, and learning-based approaches for humanoid robots

chapters.title: Advanced Kinematics
learning_objectives: Understand Denavit-Hartenberg convention for kinematic chain representation
Derive and compute Jacobian matrices for serial manipulators
Analyze singularities and workspace limitations in robot arms
Apply inverse kinematics solutions with analytical and numerical methods
Implement kinematic redundancy resolution for humanoid limbs

chapters.title: Walking & Locomotion
learning_objectives: Analyze bipedal walking dynamics and balance stability
Implement Zero Moment Point (ZMP) control strategies
Design Central Pattern Generator (CPG) for rhythmic locomotion
Apply Model Predictive Control (MPC) for walking gait generation
Evaluate walking performance metrics and robustness

chapters.title: Manipulation & Grasping
learning_objectives: Understand grasp planning principles and stability metrics
Analyze force closure and grasp quality measures
Implement grasp synthesis algorithms for dexterous manipulation
Design control policies for multi-finger grasping
Apply tactile feedback integration for adaptive grasping

chapters.title: Whole-Body Control
learning_objectives: Design hierarchical control architectures for humanoid robots
Implement task-space control with priority-based task management
Apply whole-body optimization for motion generation
Balance multiple control objectives with constraint handling
Integrate proprioceptive feedback in whole-body control loops

chapters.title: Learning-Based Control
learning_objectives: Apply reinforcement learning to robot control problems
Design neural network policies for continuous control
Implement imitation learning from expert demonstrations
Tune hyperparameters for stable learning convergence
Evaluate learning-based control performance and safety

chapters.title: Debugging & Troubleshooting
learning_objectives: Diagnose and resolve common control system failures
Use logging and visualization tools for debugging
Implement hardware diagnostics and safety checks
Analyze performance bottlenecks in real-time systems
Create robust error handling and recovery strategies

learning_paths.name: Advanced Robot Control
learning_paths.description: Focus on control architectures and algorithms

learning_paths.name: Humanoid Locomotion
learning_paths.description: Emphasis on walking and balanced motion
